levels.surface: محمّد بن محمّد بن عصام الكلينيّ

notes: Al-Faqih states his routes («فقد رويته عن») to al-Kulayni: no saying, so needs_ruling (rule 11).
The three names are alternatives at one level, and Kulayni is the source of the book.
«عنهم عنه عن رجاله» is a general statement of routes, not a named link; left out.
«رضي اللّه عنهم» is removed as a blessing.
